**亡領**家具系列，適用於 [**Fantasy's Furniture**](https://modrinth.com/mod/fantasy-furniture)，包含功能完整的家具，包括但不限於：**箱子**、**抽屜**、**床**、**座椅****等！** 此家具系列的設計靈感來自於《魔獸世界：暗影之境》中的**亡領**誓盟。
若要合成**亡領磚塊**/**亡領羊毛**，你需要放入 **#minecraft:stone_crafting_materials**/**#minecraft:wool**。 ![磚塊-切石機](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ApexStudios-Dev/.github/refs/heads/master/assets/minecraft/fantasyfurniture_necrolord/stonecutter_bricks.png) ![羊毛-切石機](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ApexStudios-Dev/.github/refs/heads/master/assets/minecraft/fantasyfurniture_necrolord/stonecutter_wool.png) 若要合成**亡領**家具方塊，你需要將 **#fantasyfurniture:binding_agent**、**亡領磚塊** 和 **亡領羊毛** 放入**家具工作站** ![家具工作站](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ApexStudios-Dev/.github/refs/heads/master/assets/minecraft/fantasyfurniture_necrolord/furniture_station.png)
